Parchley acknowledgements

Parchley uses pdf-inspector 1.17.0 under its upstream license. OCR packaging uses PDFium native-v7988 and ONNX Runtime 1.27.0, with license and third-party notice files copied from their exact release archives by Scripts/fetch-ocr-assets.sh. PP-OCRv6 Small model artifacts are downloaded from the pinned oar-ocr v0.7.0 release under the license stated in Vendor/Manifests/pp-ocrv6-small.json.

The release bundle must include the upstream license text and third-party notices for every binary and model artifact actually shipped. This acknowledgement is not a substitute for those files.
